'''Puffbelly''' is a [[Fire]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Blowfin]] at 6 bronze stars/19 copies, and evolves into [[Chefugu]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "This aspiring master chef is ready to put on the signature headband and take a slice at those Zobos. Though, Puffbelly is a bit fixated on cutting everything to the right size."

Puffbelly is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Puffbelly's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Chefugu]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Puffbelly to increase stats 3 time(s).
* In [[Island Goldrush]], use Energy Drink x5,000.
